name: logseq-bonofix-theme
author: Sansui233
description: A clean theme for Logseq, focusing on long time writing experience.

scripts.build: sass source/index.scss custom.css --no-source-map && npx uglifycss custom.css --output custom.css
scripts.build:db: sass source/db.scss custom-db.css --no-source-map && uglifycss custom-db.css --output custom-db.css
